excluded: Not full TCP: inherits tcp-data finite16-byte/SMSS4/immediateACK/explicitflush/RTO profile and original uncovered ACK/window/reassembly cases
Fixed rawIPv4 tuple/atomic/IHL5; TCP20 or SYNACK MSS-only24; no IPoptions/fragments/generalTCPoptions/ECN/URG/multiconnection/ARP/Ethernet
Legacy network descriptors retained as unused schema only; all are always model_gap; no descriptor bypass or handwritten codec
PSHACK data admitted; receive API does not expose PUSH, every nonempty wire output segment setsPSH; not record framing/general scheduling guarantee

WIRE-PROFILE.interpretation: Finite raw IPv4 TCP wire transport of unchanged tcp-data protocol state/actions; unsupported domain remains model_gap. Drops modify only wire disposition.

WIRE-IP.interpretation: Explicit fixed IPv4 layout, Total Length and header checksum; atomic ID0 output/any input ID within RFC6864 profile.

WIRE-TCP.interpretation: Explicit sequence/ack/window/flags, Data Offset, checksum and pseudoheader, with only declared fixed option shapes.

WIRE-MSS.interpretation: SYNACK may carry only kind2,length4,MSS>=4; existing SMSS4 output remains at or below offered MSS; no negotiation/storage fork.

WIRE-PUSH.interpretation: Profile sends every nonempty segment with PSHACK and accepts ACK/PSHACK data through the same original byte/sequence rules; receive API does not expose optional PUSH flag. Explicit flush service remains an environment scheduling contract.
